name: Serbia
description: Serbia is a parliamentary republic in Southeastern Europe, successor of the Yugoslav federation, with Belgrade at the confluence of the Danube and Sava. It is an upper-middle-income economy reorienting from state industry toward automotive components, food processing, and ICT services, carried by a deep engineering tradition: the Mihajlo Pupin Institute's automation and computing lineage, the VINCA nuclear institute, and a university system anchored by the University of Belgrade. EU candidacy frames its regulatory convergence; demographic contraction and brain drain are its binding constraints.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Serbia's actor space from Yugoslav self-management and federal institutions to the republic's ministries, public research institutes, university, science funds, and export-oriented firms.

works.title: Industrial and Innovation Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of Serbia's engineering institutes, automotive and food sectors, ICT services, and integration into European value chains.

works.title: Regional Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of districts, the Belgrade-Novi Sad corridor, transport infrastructure, and spatial concentration of research and industrial clusters.
